title: Claude Code skill turns a one-line machine description into a physics-driven 3D simulation
summary: Given a single line like "a turbofan jet engine", Claude researches the real machine, writes a small physics solver and builds an interactive three.js cutaway in one HTML file, plus a recorded film. Examples include engines and refinery pumps for training.
agent_role: Claude researches dimensions and physics, builds the model, solver and interactive modes; the human writes the one-line prompt and runs the recording script.
outcome: Author reports example outputs such as a turbofan producing about 340 kN from a Brayton cycle solver with 3,597 parts, each generated from a single prompt line.

curation.rationale: An original skill with a gallery of one-line-prompt results (turbofan, rocket engine, process pump, compressor) and open code, though it reads partly as a launch post and the outputs are not independently checked.
